item.title: Episode 1: Welcome to the Wire - The Weights Landed
item.itunes:author: Anmol
item.description:
The first episode of The AI Daily Wire. Moonshot AI published the full weights for Kimi K3 — a 2.8-trillion-parameter model — and almost everything else this week is a reaction to it. Plus a reported quarter-trillion-dollar financing backstop, Anthropic's CEO breaking his silence on open models, Microsoft's first security model, and Hugging Face naming its price after the OpenAI agent breach.
## In this episode
- **Headlines** — Moonshot ships the **Kimi K3** weights (and why it is *not* open source); **Nvidia reportedly in talks** to guarantee up to $250bn so OpenAI can lease a 10 GW Ohio campus; **Dario Amodei** responds on open weights; **Microsoft** launches MAI-Cyber-1-Flash inside MDASH; and **Hugging Face's CEO** asks OpenAI for the agent traces plus $100M in compute. - **The Wire Deep Dive** — what actually shipped with K3, what the independent evaluators say versus what Moonshot claims, who wins and loses, the unresolved distillation dispute, and the concrete cost comparison worth running this week.
## Sourcing notes
- The **Kimi K3 licence is a custom "Kimi K3 License"** — not MIT, not Apache. Several outlets have this wrong. Open weights and open source are not the same thing. - Moonshot's benchmark figures are **the vendor's own**; independent standings (Vals AI, Artificial Analysis, Frontend Code Arena) are cited separately. - The **Nvidia backstop is talks-stage and anonymously sourced**. Nvidia declined to comment. - **Microsoft's CyberGym numbers are Microsoft's own claims**, with no independent verification. - The **distillation allegation is an unresolved dispute**, not a finding.
## Sources
- [Kimi K3 — Hugging Face model card](https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3) · [licence](https://huggingface.co/moonshotai/Kimi-K3/blob/main/LICENSE) - [Kimi K3 open weights — The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/kimi-k3-open-weights/) · [coding head-to-head](https://thenewstack.io/kimi-k3-fable-coding-benchmark/) - [The open-weights escalation — Nathan Lambert, Interconnects](https://www.interconnects.ai/p/kimi-k3-the-open-weights-escalation) - [Nvidia–OpenAI $250bn backstop talks — CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/27/nvidia-and-openai-in-talks-for-up-to-250-billion-dollar-ai-backstop.html) - [Our position on open-weights models — Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/news/position-open-weights-models) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/anthropics-dario-amodei-responds-doesnt-oppose-open-weight-models-but-fears-chinese-ai/) - [MAI-Cyber-1-Flash inside MDASH — Microsoft](https://microsoft.ai/news/introducing-mai-cyber-1-flash-inside-mdash/) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/27/microsoft-launches-its-first-cyber-model-and-a-new-agentic-cybersecurity-system/) - [Hugging Face CEO calls for radical transparency — TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/26/hugging-face-ceo-calls-for-radical-transparency-after-unprecedented-openai-hack/) · [Hugging Face incident disclosure](https://huggingface.co/blog/security-incident-july-2026) - [White House accuses Moonshot of distillation — CyberScoop](https://cyberscoop.com/white-house-accuses-moonshot-ai-anthropic-model-distillation/)
## Built by
This show is made by a solo developer who builds things in his spare time. If any of it is useful to you, these are the projects behind it:
- **Handled** — done-for-you content and AI agent workflows for creators and busy professionals. Get in touch: **handled.anmol@gmail.com** - **Culmen Games** — an indie Android game studio. Get in touch: **studiosculmen@gmail.com**
Both are early-stage and built in the open. Questions, ideas, or just want to say hi? Either address above reaches me.
